channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Assam polls 2026: CM names Lakhimpur, Dhakuakhana picks; seat-sharing by Feb 15
item.description: Sarma says AGP is free to field candidates; alliance decisions & competition will be settled amicably

item.title: Northeast’s first highway emergency landing strip to open in Feb: Assam CM
item.description: High-profile launch planned; PM or Defence Minister may inaugurate Northeast’s first highway airstrip, says Sarma

item.title: IIT Guwahati researchers develop sunlight-driven method to convert CO₂ into methanol
item.description: The present work is expected to contribute towards mitigating environmental problems with simultaneous contribution towards green energy.

item.title: Arunachal CS reviews Siang Upper Project, calls for coordination on PFR activities
item.description: The Chief Secretary chaired a high-level meeting here on Wednesday to review the security preparedness and administrative arrangements for the pre-feasibility report (PFR) activities

item.title: Dying declaration only lead in East Jaintia Hills explosion case: Meghalaya Police
item.description: It has been reported that Ashok Tamang, one of the victims, died at the Shillong Civil Hospital on January 1. The identity of the other victim is still unknown.

item.title: Arsenic-tainted water endangers public health, damages Rabi cultivation in Bokakhat
item.description: Farmers of Kuruwabahi have demanded irrigation arrangements that would allow the use of water from natural sources instead of arsenic-contaminated groundwater.

item.title: No roads, no votes: Palasbari villagers protest erosion, warn of poll boycott
item.description: According to the protesters, Palasbari MLA Hemanga Thakuria had assured development work in the area about a year ago, but no concrete steps have been taken so far.

item.title: Bangladesh-linked jihadi network radicalised Assam youth via Social Media: Police
item.description: Investigation into the arrest of 11 IMK members in Assam reveals cross-border connections with Bangladesh and West Bengal

item.title: Human-elephant conflict turns deadly in Hojai, third life lost since New Year
item.description: The latest incident occurred on the night of January 4 in the Radhanagar area of Hojai, where a middle-aged man was trampled to death.

item.title: Faith chose life and gave India a singing sensation
item.description: Mizoram’s child singing sensation Esther Hnamte rose through faith and talent to win the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar and perform at Mumbai’s Antilia
